text:
Nina: Heads up — I'll take the 10:30 slot in us-east to roll the routing tweak (small change, no model weights). Target window 10:30-11:00. Canary traffic 10% for 15m. Rollback is pin to model-v1.23.
Sara: sounds good, I can own the smoke checks. ping me when canary starts. :thumbsup:
Mike: any infra changes or DB migrations?
Nina: none. purely routing config + a tweak to batching policy. No schema work.
Larry: Ops: I'll standby for rollback and infra alerts. Set me as backup smoke owner if Sara is tied up.
Sara: good call. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results. plan to start at 10:35 after canary ramp shows healthy metrics.
Nina: deploy plan TL;DR:
```
- deploy at 10:30 UTC  (us-east)
- ramp to 10% canary over 2m
- hold 15m, monitor latency + error-rate
- if healthy -> ramp to 100% over 10m
- rollback if 5xx > 1% or latency p95 increases > 40% vs baseline
```
Mike: can you drop the quick heatmap of p95 after the canary starts? I can check traces.
Sara: will do. smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) smoke endpoints: /health /infer/test
2) example prompt sanity
3) end-to-end latency < 800ms p95
4) no increase in error-rate or OOMs
5) logs show no KV cache misses spike
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job 1761112222 by Nina to us-east at 10:30 UTC. Canary policy: 10% for 15m.
Nina: tagging the routes in console config: `route: inference-routing/v2` and `fallback: model-v1.23`
Sara: smoke run started 10:36 — initial checks passing (health OK, sample infer good). p95 ~ 420ms.
Larry: adding a quick watch: alert channel #eng-oncall-loop, I've set mem/CPU thresholds and ramp abort trigger.
Mike: traces look clean for the sample requests. No errors in canary logs.
Sara: canary at 10% for 15m and holding. continuing to monitor. posting updates every 5m.
Nina: thanks team. If anything looks off, we rollback to model-v1.23 and revert the route.
Sara: 10:45 smoke OK, p95 stable. moving to ramp -> 50%
Mike: 10:52 p95 still stable, error-rate flat.
Larry: no infra alarms. standing down.
Sara: 11:00 ramp to 100% complete. smoke final: PASS. :tada:
Nina: great — marking slot complete and updating release board. note: follow-up to tweak batching window next week.
Sara: closing this thread, will file a short post-deploy note in the release doc. :memo:
